description: This file is a PHP source script for the web interface of a network device, specifically handling the 'Add Port Forwarding Service' page. It includes server-side PHP code for dynamic content and client-side JavaScript for form validation, user interaction, and AJAX communication.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string into its expanded array form, handling '::' shorthand notation.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks if form inputs with a given prefix are all blank, ignoring specific fields.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates value of form fields with a given prefix, separated by specified separator.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address inputs are required based on current form state.

methods.name: ipv6_in_int
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 address segment array into integer form for range comparisons.

methods.name: isHex
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid hexadecimal number.

methods.name: validate_v6addr_pool
methods.description: Checks that the end IPv6 address is numerically greater than the start address.

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Checks if IPv4 server address input is required based on form state.
